name: Question 3
problem:
Find the distance between the vector $x$ and the subspace spanned by the linearly independent vectors ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2}},$ where

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
The orthogonal projection of $x$ onto the subspace spanned by the columns of a matrix $A$ is given by

$$
{\text{proj}}_{S}\,x=A({A}^{T}\,A)^{-1}\,{A}^{T}\,x.
$$

In our case, we have 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}| & | \\ {a}_{1} & {a}_{2} \\ | & |\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\,⟹\,{A}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, we get the following projection: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{S}\,x & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\cdot {([\begin{aligned}0 & -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}]\,\cdot \,[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}])}^{-1}\,\,\,\,\cdot \,[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\cdot {[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]}^{-1}\cdot [\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\cdot \frac{1}{3}[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]=\overset{^}{x}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Finally, the distance between $x$ and the subspace $S$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}d(x,\overset{^}{x}) & =‖x-\overset{^}{x}‖ \\  & =\sqrt{({x}_{1}-{\overset{^}{x}}_{1})^{2}+({x}_{2}-{\overset{^}{x}}_{2})^{2}+({x}_{3}-{\overset{^}{x}}_{3})^{2}+({x}_{4}-{\overset{^}{x}}_{4})^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(0-1)^{2}+(0-(-1))^{2}+(3-2)^{2}+(1-0)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1+1+1+1} \\  & =\sqrt{4} \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Find the distance between the vector x and the subspace spanned by the linearly independent vectors {a1,a2}, where a1=[0−110],a2=[1010],x=[0031].

EXPLANATION

The orthogonal projection of x onto the subspace spanned by the columns of a matrix A is given by projSx=A(ATA)−1ATx. In our case, we have A=[||a1a2||]=[01−101100]⟹AT=[0−1101010].

Therefore, we get the following projection: projSx=[01−101100]⋅([0−1101010]⋅[01−101100])−1⋅[0−1101010]⋅[0031]=[01−101100]⋅[2112]−1⋅[33]=[01−101100]⋅13[2−1−12]⋅[33]=[01−101100]⋅[11]=[1−120]=x^

Finally, the distance between x and the subspace S is given by d(x,x^)=‖x−x^‖=(x1−x^1)2+(x2−x^2)2+(x3−x^3)2+(x4−x^4)2=(0−1)2+(0−(−1))2+(3−2)2+(1−0)2=1+1+1+1=4=2.
